raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batches 12-14 carry status 'SETTLED' instead of 'POSTED' after the 2026-01-16 payments-source rename, which the change notes say has the same meaning. silver_transactions filters on status = 'POSTED' only, so those batches are dropped entirely, which explains the 0 rows reaching silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
